design: Tall lean archivist with a narrow angular high forehead, slim four mandibles and short platinum dreadlocks tied in a narrow back knot. Long charcoal sleeveless scholar robe made from two broad straight panels, pale edged shoulder yoke, high soft collar, belt with one thin rectangular record pouch. Holds a bronze-framed archive slate flat at chest with left hand while right hand hovers a small stylus above it. Slate-grey spotted hide.
